node.title: L1 affine split-pencil cross-determinant uniqueness
node.statement: In one fixed bounded-mark support/syndrome cell, any two exact saturated monic pairs have cross determinant Delta=W_0F_1-W_1F_0 satisfying product_i L_Ti | J Delta and deg(J Delta)<=2d+v. Hence the cell is a singleton whenever t ell>2d+v. Since v<=p, the entire region t ell>2d+p is polynomial per source chart, and every potentially nonsingleton arbitrary-locator cell lies in ceil((d-p+1)/ell)<=t_dense<=floor((2d+p)/ell). In strip d=m ell+eta, t_dense>=2m+1 and 2eta+p<ell is paid without any common-pencil hypothesis.
